subject: [hw] opus-dec1 -> DEC01: review of ap/n2ap_vdec.c (1559 lines, 17:4x): 3 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM - exact fixes
body:
Checked against the vendor behaviour measured with dec1/vdec_ref.c (run_ref.sh PASS 3/3).
H1 n2ap_vdec_decode() 2-plane output: :1422-1431 is dead code and :1447-1450 writes fb_dma[1] = 0, fb_fd[1] = 0. The vendor reports MM21 with 2 planes (fb_sz[0] Y, fb_sz[1] C) and programs fb_dma[1] as the chroma target: on the phone that is a DMA write to PA 0. Fix: add to struct n2ap_vdec_job `uint32_t fb_c_handle; int32_t fb_c_fd;` (header), look it up like fb_handle, set dec.fb_dma[1]/fb_fd[1], require it when vsi.pic.fb_sz[1] != 0 (or allow c in the same buffer: fb_c_handle == fb_handle -> fb_dma[1] = fb_pa + vsi.pic.fb_sz[0], same fd) and set vsi.dec.fb_num_planes = 2 (cfg default 2 for H.264/HEVC instead of "leave 0").
H2 No harvest after START: in sync mode (one fb in vsi.dec per START) the vendor NEVER sends PUT_FRAME_BUFFER (measured: P=0 over 12 AUs) - the kernel harvests after vdec_if_decode() (mtk_vcodec_dec.c worker: get_param DISP/FREE_FRAME_BUFFER). n2ap_vdec_decode() and n2ap_vdec_flush() must run the dec_put_frame_buffer() harvest after the ACK (and keep it on 0xC002). Without it pop_displayed() returns nothing forever.
H3 list_free_bs is never drained: the vendor pushes every consumed bitstream cookie (measured: one per START, same START) and the ring has 64 entries; after 64 AUs it is full. Drain it in the same harvest (read_idx++, count--, kernel vdec_get_bs) and expose n2ap_vdec_pop_free_bs(d, &bs_cookie) or just count it in stats.
M1 fb passed through the job (not push_fb) is never put in in_use[], so dec_fb_by_cookie() fails in the harvest and the displayed planes are not synced from_device. Register job fbs in in_use too (cookie = fb_handle as you set vdec_fb_va).
M2 general_buf_fd = -1 only when a fb is present (:1451); the header START (no fb) must set it too (else vendor log "ion_import failed ... general buffer").
M3 reuse rule: a buffer may go back to free_q only when list_free returned it AND the client released the displayed picture; make that explicit in the API comment (list_free can come before list_disp for the same cookie with B-frames).
Test oracle you can use now: port vdec_ref.c main() onto your API in test_dec01 and expect, on t320b (-bf 2, 12 AUs, VR_FAKEIRQ style WAITISR), 12 displayed in pts order 1000,1002,1003,1001,1005,1004,1007,1008,1006,1010,1011,1009 (with pts = 1000 + decode index) and 12 freed; 1080p 6/6. Note the vendor leaves y_fb_dma/c_fb_dma = 0 and poc = 0 in list_disp entries: identify buffers by cookie only.
